blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Commission on Audit (COA) has directed the Mandaue City government to investigate the incomplete delivery of a P58.13-million school supply procurement after finding that thousands of pairs of rubber shoes were not delivered with the kits despite the transaction being fully paid. The audit finding involved 17,100 school supply kits for Grade 1 to 3 pupils procured by the city through the Special Education Fund (SEF) at a total contract price of P58,129,911. Each kit was supposed to include a customized backpack, a PE uniform, customized rubber shoes, notebooks, writing paper, a sharpener, a pencil case […]...
